cover letter
Bachelor's degree in related area and / or equivalent experience / training. (Required)

The Business Operations Manager oversees and coordinates a full range of administrative operations for the Bakar Bio Labs, Berkeley, the incubator operating within the Bakar Labs overall ecosystem. The position is responsible for ensuring seamless day-to-day operations of the incubator. The responsibilities are significantly complex involving budgetary and financial management, real estate management, and professional communication with incubator staff and tenant companies.
Tenant Onboarding, Support, And Termination - 40%

Reporting to the Managing Director of Operations and Finance, the Business Operations Manager uses advanced administrative concepts and mature judgement to resolve complex issues and general administration management at a high level for Bakar Bio Labs, Berkeley. The incumbent develops, maintains, and modifies processes and procedures that sustain efficient operations. They regularly work on highly complex issues where analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of variable factors and exercises judgment in selecting methods, techniques, and evaluation criteria for obtaining results. Poor decisions or failure to achieve goals may adversely affect the overall performance of the program.
In coordination with the incubator management team, make tenant space assignment recommendations and execute tenant lease/termination/amendments.

The Business Operations Manager will supervise professional staff. Additionally, they lead and/or support activities related to purchasing, budget and resource management, communications, and facilities, and serve as the liaison for partners on purchasing, and reimbursements. The role includes responsibility for making office space assignments, oversight of tenant leases, and providing excellent support to existing and potential tenants.
Maintain tenant leasing data including required insurance, lease end dates, and space assignments.
Manage cardkey assignments according to incubator staff and tenant staff changes.
Track tenant space assignments, the use of in-house premium services and adjustments.
Create and send invoices for monthly lease costs and monthly user services costs to appropriate tenant contact.
Ensure accuracy on invoiced amounts and follow up to ensure payment is timely and deposited into the correct Campus accounts.
Monitor all income from tenant leases, tenant premium services, and industry partnership revenue.
Recognize and take action to rectify irregularities.
Suggest concrete steps to enhance overall revenue.
At the direction of the Managing Director, perform and/or oversee special projects or assignments that are sensitive or complex in nature.
Manage all tenant and team interactions with a high degree of professionalism and a customer-service-oriented attitude.
Ensure tasks are completed in a timely manner.
Daily Office Operations And Facilities Management - 30%
Manage incubator-specific software (e.g., non-campus software like Airtable, Freshdesk, Skedda, Quickbooks, etc.)

Assist in technical troubleshooting on facility repairs/maintenance questions; project manage the resolution of facilities issues in a timely manner. The business operations manager will gain a high degree of familiarity with the facility to help make informed operational decisions.

Coordinate work with business operations managers at two (2) other incubators, across four (4) total facilities, across two (2) UC campuses. Identify potential efficiencies and provide recommendations to standardize policies, streamline cross-campus operations, and leverage shared operational resources.
Supervision of Direct Reports - 20%
Supervise a small group of professional staff in the areas of financial analysis, facilities, front desk and data support.
Provide operational guidance to team members as needed.
Lead administrative team to ensure all day-to-day issues are resolved in a timely manner.
Delegate tasks to team members, track progress, and ensure deadlines are met.
Coach employees as needed.
Handle escalations to the human resources team.
High Level Budgeting, Planning, And Cashflow Recording - 10%
Provide analysis for highly complex budgetary funding, capital, and operating projects, with multiple funding sources.
Assist the Managing Director with budget creation and reporting on key performance indicators. Represent the department on business affairs to the campus community.
Manage budget and forecast for the enterprise.
Report significant variances that impact operations.
Leverage existing purchasing and accounting campus resources to create processes which accurately and efficiently track all income and expenses for the incubator.

Advanced knowledge of a variety of administrative operational activities such as event planning, facilities management, risk management planning, tenant/vendor management, accounting and payroll, and contracts regulations and guidelines.
Advanced knowledge of and/or ability to learn University rules and regulations, processes, protocols and procedures for budget, accounting and fund management, and / or personnel management.
Advanced interpersonal skills including verbal and written communication, active listening, critical thinking, persuasiveness, advising and counseling skills.
Advanced knowledge of and/or ability to learn common University-specific computer application programs.
Ability to use discretion and maintain confidentiality.
Advanced skills in short- and long-term strategic planning, analysis, problem-solving and customer service.
Advanced knowledge of financial analysis and reporting techniques, and / or human resources policies and procedures for staff and academic employees.
